test_index_to_frame: test the Index.to_frame method converts an index to a DataFrame with correct column name and index reference
test_index_droplevel: test the Index.droplevel method raises ValueError when removing levels from a single-level index
test_index_rename: test the Index.rename and set_names methods change index name and raise TypeError for non-hashable names
test_index_unique: test the Index.unique method returns a deduplicated index and handles NaN values correctly
test_index_drop_duplicates: test the Index.drop_duplicates method removes duplicate values and the duplicated method flags duplicates
